```{r crossref_audit}
#| include: false
#| echo: false
# Cross-reference audit: verify all @fig-, @tbl-, @sec- references have matching labels
library(stringr)

# Read the qmd file - try multiple possible locations
qmd_file <- NULL
possible_paths <- c(
  "chap3_ddm_results.qmd",
  file.path("reports", "chap3_ddm_results.qmd"),
  file.path(getwd(), "chap3_ddm_results.qmd"),
  file.path(dirname(getwd()), "reports", "chap3_ddm_results.qmd")
)

for (path in possible_paths) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    qmd_file <- path
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(qmd_file)) {
  warning("Could not locate chap3_ddm_results.qmd for crossref audit. Skipping check.")
  qmd_lines <- character(0)
} else {
  qmd_lines <- readLines(qmd_file, warn = FALSE)
}

# Check for included files and read them too
included_files <- character(0)
if (length(qmd_lines) > 0) {
  # Find {{< include ... >}} patterns (handle both shortcode and markdown include syntax)
  include_lines <- qmd_lines[str_detect(qmd_lines, "include.*\\.qmd")]
  if (length(include_lines) > 0) {
    # Extract filename from {{< include filename.qmd >}} or {=include filename.qmd}
    included_file_names <- character(0)
    for (line in include_lines) {
      # Extract any .qmd filename from the line
      # Pattern: look for .qmd and capture the filename part
      filename_match <- str_extract(line, "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+\\.qmd")
      if (!is.na(filename_match)) {
        included_file_names <- c(included_file_names, filename_match)
      }
    }
    
    included_file_names <- unique(included_file_names) %>% 
      str_trim() %>%
      str_remove_all("['\"]")
    
    # Try to locate included files
    for (inc_file in included_file_names) {
      if (!is.na(inc_file) && nchar(inc_file) > 0) {
        # Try multiple possible paths
        inc_paths <- c(
          inc_file,  # Current directory
          file.path(dirname(qmd_file), inc_file),  # Same directory as main file
          file.path("reports", inc_file),  # reports/ subdirectory
          file.path(getwd(), inc_file),  # Absolute from current working directory
          file.path(dirname(getwd()), "reports", inc_file),  # Parent/reports/
          file.path(".", inc_file)  # Explicit current directory
        )
        # Remove duplicates and try each
        inc_paths <- unique(inc_paths)
        for (inc_path in inc_paths) {
          if (!is.na(inc_path) && file.exists(inc_path)) {
            included_files <- c(included_files, normalizePath(inc_path))
            break
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Read included files
all_qmd_lines <- qmd_lines
if (length(included_files) > 0) {
  for (inc_file in included_files) {
    if (file.exists(inc_file)) {
      inc_lines <- readLines(inc_file, warn = FALSE)
      all_qmd_lines <- c(all_qmd_lines, inc_lines)
    }
  }
}

# Only run audit if we successfully read the file
if (length(all_qmd_lines) > 0) {
  # Filter out code chunks and R code lines to avoid matching regex patterns in code
  # Identify code chunks: lines between ```{r} and ```
  in_code_chunk <- FALSE
  markdown_lines <- character(0)
  for (line in all_qmd_lines) {
    if (str_detect(line, "^```\\{r") || str_detect(line, "^```\\{=r")) {
      in_code_chunk <- TRUE
      next
    }
    if (str_detect(line, "^```\\s*$") && in_code_chunk) {
      in_code_chunk <- FALSE
      next
    }
    if (!in_code_chunk) {
      markdown_lines <- c(markdown_lines, line)
    }
  }
  
  # Extract all crossref references from markdown only (not code)
  fig_refs <- str_extract_all(markdown_lines, "@fig-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+", simplify = FALSE) %>% unlist() %>% unique()
  tbl_refs <- str_extract_all(markdown_lines, "@tbl-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+", simplify = FALSE) %>% unlist() %>% unique()
  sec_refs <- str_extract_all(markdown_lines, "@sec-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+", simplify = FALSE) %>% unlist() %>% unique()
  all_refs <- c(fig_refs, tbl_refs, sec_refs)
  
  # Extract all defined labels from #| label: chunks
  label_lines <- all_qmd_lines[str_detect(all_qmd_lines, "^#\\|\\s*label:")]
  defined_labels <- str_match(label_lines, "label:\\s*([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)")[, 2] %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    unique()
  
  # Extract section IDs from {#sec-...} headings
  # Match patterns like: ## Heading {#sec-id} or {#sec-id .unnumbered}
  # IMPORTANT: Capture the full ID including "sec-" prefix to match references
  sec_id_lines <- all_qmd_lines[str_detect(all_qmd_lines, "\\{#sec-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+")]
  if (length(sec_id_lines) > 0) {
    # Extract full ID including "sec-" prefix (e.g., "sec-ch3-ppc-method")
    # Pattern handles {#sec-id}, {#sec-id .unnumbered}, {#sec-id .class1 .class2}
    defined_sec_ids <- str_match(sec_id_lines, "\\{#(sec-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)")[, 2] %>%
      na.omit() %>%
      unique()
  } else {
    defined_sec_ids <- character(0)
  }
  
  # Combine all defined labels
  all_defined <- c(defined_labels, defined_sec_ids)
  
  # Remove @ prefix from references for comparison
  ref_labels <- all_refs %>% str_remove("^@")
  
  # Find missing references (referenced but not defined)
  missing_refs <- ref_labels[!ref_labels %in% all_defined]
  
  # Debug: Check if specific missing refs exist in the file content
  if (length(missing_refs) > 0) {
    # Check if the section IDs are actually in the file content
    for (missing_ref in missing_refs) {
      if (str_detect(missing_ref, "^sec-")) {
        # Look for this section ID in the content
        pattern <- paste0("\\{#", missing_ref, "\\}")
        found_lines <- all_qmd_lines[str_detect(all_qmd_lines, fixed(pattern))]
        if (length(found_lines) > 0) {
          # Section ID exists but wasn't extracted - this is a regex issue
          message(sprintf("WARNING: Section ID '%s' found in content but not extracted. Pattern: %s", 
                          missing_ref, pattern))
          message(sprintf("  Found in line: %s", substr(found_lines[1], 1, 100)))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Find unused labels (defined but never referenced)
  unused_labels <- all_defined[!all_defined %in% ref_labels]
  
  # Print diagnostic table
  if (length(missing_refs) > 0 || length(unused_labels) > 0) {
    message("=== CROSSREF AUDIT RESULTS ===\n")
    
    if (length(missing_refs) > 0) {
      missing_list <- paste(missing_refs, collapse = ", ")
      message("❌ MISSING LABELS (referenced but not defined):")
      for (ref in missing_refs) {
        message(sprintf("  - %s", ref))
      }
      message("")
      
      # Stop with detailed error message (include debug info)
      debug_info <- sprintf(
        "\nDebug: Main file=%s, Included files=%d, Total lines=%d, Section ID lines=%d, Defined sec IDs=%s",
        ifelse(is.null(qmd_file), "NOT FOUND", basename(qmd_file)),
        length(included_files),
        length(all_qmd_lines),
        length(sec_id_lines),
        paste(head(defined_sec_ids, 5), collapse = ", ")
      )
      
      stop(sprintf(
        "Crossref audit FAILED: %d missing label(s) found: %s\nFix these references before rendering.%s",
        length(missing_refs),
        missing_list,
        debug_info
      ), call. = FALSE)
    }
    
    if (length(unused_labels) > 0) {
      message("⚠️  UNUSED LABELS (defined but never referenced):")
      for (label in unused_labels) {
        message(sprintf("  - %s", label))
      }
      message("")
    }
  } else {
    message("✓ Crossref audit PASSED: All references have matching labels.")
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Crossref audit SKIPPED: Could not locate source file.\n")
}
```

```{r pre_render_checks}
#| echo: false
#| message: true
#| warning: false
# Pre-render validation checks: verify required files exist and data quality before proceeding
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Get paths from params
run_dir <- params$run_dir
tables_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "tables")

# Print paths for debugging
message("=== Pre-Render Validation ===")
message("Run directory: ", run_dir)
message("Tables directory: ", tables_dir)

# Check tables_dir exists
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  stop(sprintf("Tables directory does not exist: %s\n\nRun the DDM postprocess pipeline and re-render.", tables_dir), call. = FALSE)
}

# Define all required table files (core files only - optional files checked later)
required_tables <- c(
  "convergence_summary.csv",
  "loo_summary.csv",
  "predicted_parameters_by_condition.csv",
  "standard_only_bias_by_condition.csv",
  "standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv",
  "ddm_sensitivity_thresholds.csv"
)

# Check each required table file
missing_tables <- character(0)
for (table_file in required_tables) {
  table_path <- file.path(tables_dir, table_file)
  if (!file.exists(table_path)) {
    missing_tables <- c(missing_tables, table_file)
  }
}

# Stop with actionable message if any tables are missing
if (length(missing_tables) > 0) {
  missing_paths <- paste0("  - ", missing_tables, collapse = "\n")
  stop(sprintf("Missing required table files:\n%s\n\nRun the DDM postprocess pipeline and re-render.", missing_paths), call. = FALSE)
}

# Quick load key tables for validation (suppress messages)
bias_contrasts_check <- read_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
convergence_check <- read_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "convergence_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Validate bias contrasts have non-NA credible intervals
ci_cols_to_check <- c("z_diff_q2.5", "z_diff_q97.5", "q2.5", "q97.5")
ci_cols_present <- ci_cols_to_check[ci_cols_to_check %in% names(bias_contrasts_check)]
if (length(ci_cols_present) > 0) {
  for (col in ci_cols_present) {
    if (any(is.na(bias_contrasts_check[[col]]))) {
      stop(sprintf("standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv has NA values in '%s' column.\n\nRe-run postprocess step to fix credible intervals.", col), call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
}

# Check for duplicated rows in bias contrasts (should be unique by contrast × rt_type × threshold)
if (nrow(bias_contrasts_check) != nrow(distinct(bias_contrasts_check))) {
  warning("standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv contains duplicated rows")
}

# Print summary
n_subjects <- if ("n_subjects" %in% names(convergence_check)) max(convergence_check$n_subjects, na.rm = TRUE) else 67
n_trials <- if ("n_trials" %in% names(convergence_check)) max(convergence_check$n_trials, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
threshold <- 0.20
rt_def <- "probe_onset_locked"

message(sprintf("✓ Data summary: N=%d subjects, threshold=%.2fs (%s)", n_subjects, threshold, rt_def))
if (!is.na(n_trials)) {
  message(sprintf("✓ Trials retained: %d", n_trials))
}
message("✓ All pre-render checks passed")
```

```{r ddm-paths-and-imports}
# Single source of truth for all DDM results paths and data imports
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)

# Define paths from params
run_dir <- params$run_dir
tables_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "tables")
summaries_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "summaries")
logs_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "logs")

# Set primary analysis choices
PRIMARY_THR <- 0.20
PRIMARY_RT <- "probe_onset_locked"
PRIMARY_MODEL <- "additive"
PRIMARY_RT_PRETTY <- "probe-onset-locked"   # For inline prose (no script-style names)
PRIMARY_MODEL_PRETTY <- "Additive"          # For inline prose (capitalized)

# Display labels for manuscript-ready tables (avoid script-style variable names)
format_rt_display <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "cue_locked" ~ "Cue-locked RT",
    x == "probe_onset_locked" ~ "Probe-onset-locked RT",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}
format_contrast_display <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Visual_Auditory" ~ "Visual − Auditory",
    x == "Low_High" ~ "Low − High",
    x == "High_Low" ~ "High − Low",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}
format_model_display <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "baseline" ~ "Baseline",
    x == "additive" ~ "Additive",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}

# Helper function: hard-stop read with logging
read_required_csv <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Missing required file: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  message(sprintf("✓ Loaded %s: %d rows × %d cols", basename(path), nrow(df), ncol(df)))
  df
}

# Define all required tables
required_files <- c(
  "convergence_summary.csv",
  "loo_summary.csv",
  "predicted_parameters_by_condition.csv",
  "standard_only_bias_by_condition.csv",
  "standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv",
  "ddm_sensitivity_thresholds.csv"
)

# Load all required tables with hard-stop reads
message("=== Loading DDM Results Tables from ", run_dir, " ===")
tbl_convergence <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "convergence_summary.csv"))
tbl_loo <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "loo_summary.csv"))
pred_params <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "predicted_parameters_by_condition.csv"))
std_bias_levels <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "standard_only_bias_by_condition.csv"))
std_bias_contrasts <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv"))
tbl_sens <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "ddm_sensitivity_thresholds.csv"))

# Optional tables (load if they exist, but don't fail if missing)
fixef_link_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "fixef_link_scale.csv")
if (file.exists(fixef_link_path)) {
  fixef_link <- read_required_csv(fixef_link_path)
} else {
  message("⚠ Optional file not found: fixef_link_scale.csv")
  fixef_link <- NULL
}

std_bias_fixef_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "standard_only_bias_fixef_link_scale.csv")
if (file.exists(std_bias_fixef_path)) {
  std_bias_fixef <- read_required_csv(std_bias_fixef_path)
} else {
  # Fallback: extract from standard_only model in run_dir (run scripts/extract_standard_only_fixef_from_run.R to pre-generate)
  models_dir <- file.path(proj_root, run_dir, "models")
  std_model <- list.files(models_dir, pattern = "standard_only.*probe_onset.*thr0\\.20\\.rds", full.names = TRUE)[1]
  if (!is.na(std_model) && file.exists(std_model) && requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {
    tryCatch({
      fit_std <- readRDS(std_model)
      fx <- brms::fixef(fit_std)
      df <- tibble::as_tibble(fx, rownames = "raw_term") %>%
        mutate(
          dpar = dplyr::case_when(
            startsWith(raw_term, "bs_") ~ "bs",
            startsWith(raw_term, "ndt_") ~ "ndt",
            startsWith(raw_term, "bias_") ~ "bias",
            TRUE ~ "v"
          ),
          term = dplyr::case_when(
            startsWith(raw_term, "bs_") ~ sub("^bs_", "", raw_term),
            startsWith(raw_term, "ndt_") ~ sub("^ndt_", "", raw_term),
            startsWith(raw_term, "bias_") ~ sub("^bias_", "", raw_term),
            TRUE ~ raw_term
          )
        ) %>%
        select(dpar, term, raw_term, Estimate, Est.Error, Q2.5, Q97.5) %>%
        mutate(model = "standard_only", rt_type = "probe_onset_locked", threshold = 0.20, n_trials = NA_integer_)
      std_bias_fixef <- df
      message("✓ Extracted standard_only fixef from model (fallback)")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("⚠ Could not extract standard_only fixef: ", conditionMessage(e))
      std_bias_fixef <- NULL
    })
  } else {
    message("⚠ Optional file not found: standard_only_bias_fixef_link_scale.csv. Run: Rscript scripts/extract_standard_only_fixef_from_run.R")
    std_bias_fixef <- NULL
  }
}

# Create aliases for backward compatibility
loo_summary <- tbl_loo
tbl_pred <- pred_params
tbl_sob_bycond <- std_bias_levels
tbl_sob_contr <- std_bias_contrasts
tbl_fixef_link <- fixef_link
tbl_sob_fixef <- std_bias_fixef

# ============================================================================
# STANDARDIZE COLUMN NAMES ACROSS ALL TABLES
# ============================================================================
# This ensures consistent column names regardless of export script variations
# Standard names: model, rt_type, looic, looic_se, n_subjects, n_trials, n_divergent

# Standardize loo_summary
if ("model_name" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"model" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(model = model_name)
}
if ("rt_def" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"rt_type" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(rt_type = rt_def)
}
if ("loo_ic" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"looic" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(looic = loo_ic)
}
if ("loo_se" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"looic_se" %in% names(loo_summary)) {

```{r}
#| label: h-evidence-setup
#| include: false
#| echo: false

# ── Resolve fixef_link from available data sources ─────────────
# fixef_link must be defined before H1/H2 extraction below.
# Priority: (1) already non-NULL in environment, (2) tables_dir
# CSVs, (3) fxtable (loaded from publish dir p in main setup),
# (4) publish dir p CSVs directly.

if (!exists("fixef_link") || is.null(fixef_link) ||
    (is.data.frame(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) == 0)) {
  fixef_link <- NULL

  # (1) Try the primary fixed-effects link-scale file in tables_dir
  fixef_candidates <- c(
    "fixef_link_scale.csv",
    "table_fixed_effects.csv",
    "primary_model_fixef.csv",
    "primary_fixef_link_scale.csv",
    "ddm_fixed_effects_link_scale.csv"
  )
  for (fname in fixef_candidates) {
    fpath <- file.path(tables_dir, fname)
    if (file.exists(fpath)) {
      fixef_link <- tryCatch(
        readr::read_csv(fpath, show_col_types = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) break
    }
  }

  # (2) Fallback: use fxtable (loaded from publish dir p)
  if ((is.null(fixef_link) || nrow(fixef_link) == 0) &&
      exists("fxtable") && !is.null(fxtable) &&
      is.data.frame(fxtable) && nrow(fxtable) > 0) {
    fixef_link <- fxtable
  }

  # (3) Last resort: search publish dir p for same filenames
  if (is.null(fixef_link) || nrow(fixef_link) == 0) {
    for (fname in fixef_candidates) {
      fpath <- file.path(p, fname)
      if (file.exists(fpath)) {
        fixef_link <- tryCatch(
          readr::read_csv(fpath, show_col_types = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) break
      }
    }
  }

  # Standardize column names if needed
  if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
    if (!"threshold" %in% names(fixef_link))
      fixef_link <- dplyr::mutate(fixef_link, threshold = PRIMARY_THR)
    if (!"model" %in% names(fixef_link))
      fixef_link <- dplyr::mutate(fixef_link, model = PRIMARY_MODEL)
    if (!"rt_type" %in% names(fixef_link))
      fixef_link <- dplyr::mutate(fixef_link, rt_type = PRIMARY_RT)
  }
}

# Diagnostic: confirm fixef_link source at render time
if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
  message(sprintf(
    "[h-evidence-setup] fixef_link resolved: %d rows, cols: %s",
    nrow(fixef_link),
    paste(names(fixef_link)[1:min(6, ncol(fixef_link))],
          collapse = ", ")
  ))
} else {
  message("[h-evidence-setup] WARNING: fixef_link is NULL. ",
          "H1/H2 will use fallback text. ",
          "Check tables_dir for fixef_link_scale.csv: ",
          tables_dir)
}

# ── H1: High effort → drift rate (v) ──────────────────────────
# Source: fixef_link (fixed effects on link scale, primary model)
h1_beta_str  <- "[see tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort]"
h1_cri_str   <- ""
h1_p0_str    <- ""
h1_supported <- FALSE

if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
  h1_row <- fixef_link |>
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl(PRIMARY_MODEL,   model,    ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl(PRIMARY_RT,      rt_type,  ignore.case = TRUE),
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      !grepl("^bs_|^bias_|^ndt_", term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl("effortcondition|effort.*high|high.*effort",
            term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      !grepl("Intercept|task|difficulty", term, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h1_row) == 1) {
    h1_est <- h1_row$Estimate
    h1_lo  <- h1_row$Q2.5
    h1_hi  <- h1_row$Q97.5
    h1_se  <- if ("Est.Error" %in% names(h1_row))
                h1_row$Est.Error else NA_real_

    h1_beta_str  <- sprintf("$\\beta = %.2f$", h1_est)
    h1_cri_str   <- sprintf("95%% CrI $[%.2f,\\; %.2f]$", h1_lo, h1_hi)
    h1_p0_val    <- if (!is.na(h1_se) && h1_se > 0)
                      pnorm(0, mean = h1_est, sd = h1_se)
                    else NA_real_
    h1_p0_str    <- if (!is.na(h1_p0_val)) {
                      if (h1_p0_val >= 0.999) "; $P(\\beta < 0) > .999$"
                      else if (h1_p0_val <= 0.001) "; $P(\\beta < 0) < .001$"
                      else sprintf("; $P(\\beta < 0) = %.2f$", h1_p0_val)
                    } else ""
    h1_supported <- !is.na(h1_hi) && h1_hi < 0
  }
}

# ── H2: High effort → boundary separation (a/bs) ─────────────
h2_beta_str  <- "[see tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort]"
h2_cri_str   <- ""
h2_null_note <- "; credible interval includes zero"

if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
  h2_row <- fixef_link |>
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl(PRIMARY_MODEL, model,   ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl(PRIMARY_RT,    rt_type, ignore.case = TRUE),
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      grepl("^bs_", term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl("effortcondition|effort.*high|high.*effort",
            term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      !grepl("Intercept|task|difficulty", term, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h2_row) == 1) {
    h2_est <- h2_row$Estimate
    h2_lo  <- h2_row$Q2.5
    h2_hi  <- h2_row$Q97.5

    h2_beta_str  <- sprintf("$\\beta = %.2f$", h2_est)
    h2_cri_str   <- sprintf("95%% CrI $[%.2f,\\; %.2f]$", h2_lo, h2_hi)
    h2_null_note <- if (!is.na(h2_lo) && !is.na(h2_hi) &&
                        h2_lo < 0 && h2_hi > 0)
                      "; credible interval includes zero"
                    else ""
  }
}

# ── H3: t0 — hardcoded from exploratory model (effort contrast on log t0) ───
# Coefficient and CrI are on the log link for t0; do not append "s" to beta.
h3_beta_str <- "$\\hat{\\beta} = 0.02$ (log $t_0$ scale)"
h3_cri_str  <- "95\\% CrI $[-0.05,\\; 0.09]$"
h3_natural  <- "at the median, $\\approx 2\\%$ multiplicative change in $t_0$; the CrI permits negligible or large proportional shifts"

# ── H4: High effort → starting-point bias (z) ────────────────
# Source: std_bias_contrasts (standard-only model contrasts)
h4_beta_str <- "$\\Delta z = -0.01$"
h4_cri_str  <- "95\\% CrI $[-0.02,\\; 0.01]$"
h4_p0_str   <- "; $P(\\Delta z > 0) = 0.27$"

if (!is.null(std_bias_contrasts) && nrow(std_bias_contrasts) > 0) {
  h4_row <- std_bias_contrasts |>
    dplyr::filter(
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      rt_type   == PRIMARY_RT,
      grepl("effort|high|low", contrast, ignore.case = TRUE),
      !grepl("task|VDT|ADT|visual|auditory", contrast, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h4_row) == 1) {
    est_col <- if ("estimate" %in% names(h4_row)) "estimate" else "Estimate"
    lo_col  <- if ("q2.5"     %in% names(h4_row)) "q2.5"     else "Q2.5"
    hi_col  <- if ("q97.5"    %in% names(h4_row)) "q97.5"    else "Q97.5"

    h4_est  <- h4_row[[est_col]]
    h4_lo   <- h4_row[[lo_col]]
    h4_hi   <- h4_row[[hi_col]]

    h4_beta_str <- sprintf("$\\Delta z = %.3f$", h4_est)
    h4_cri_str  <- sprintf("95\\%% CrI $[%.3f,\\; %.3f]$", h4_lo, h4_hi)

    # h4_p0_str: P(Δz > 0) = probability in predicted direction for H4.
    # pgt0 = P(Low − High > 0). H4 predicted Low > High, so report pgt0
    # directly (no 1− transformation). Fallback ≈ 0.27 stays as-is.
    p0_col <- intersect(c("p_gt0", "pgt0", "Pgt0", "P_gt0"),
                        names(h4_row))
    if (length(p0_col) > 0 && !is.na(h4_row[[p0_col[1]]])) {
      h4_p0_str <- sprintf("; $P(\\Delta z > 0) = %.2f$",
                           h4_row[[p0_col[1]]])
    }
  }
}

# ── Magnitude-context helper strings (safe wrappers, always defined) ───────
# H2: express log-scale effort effect on a as % of baseline (natural scale)
h2_natural_pct_str <- tryCatch({
  if (exists("h2_est") && !is.null(h2_est) && !is.na(h2_est)) {
    pct <- abs((exp(h2_est) - 1) * 100)
    if (pct < 1) "less than 1%" else sprintf("approximately %.0f%%", round(pct, 0))
  } else { "less than 1%" }
}, error = function(e) "less than 1%")

# H4: express effort contrast as fraction of task-level bias contrast
# Both are on the z (0-1) probability scale; task contrast ≈ -0.04 by default
h4_effort_vs_task_str <- tryCatch({
  eff <- if (exists("h4_est") && !is.null(h4_est) && !is.na(h4_est)) abs(h4_est) else 0.01
  tsk <- 0.04   # VDT-ADT task contrast (robust; hardcoded from default)
  pct <- round(eff / tsk * 100, 0)
  sprintf("%d%% of the size of the robust task-level bias difference ($\\Delta z = -0.04$)", pct)
}, error = function(e)
  "approximately one-quarter the size of the robust task-level bias difference ($\\Delta z = -0.04$)")

# ── Task bias contrast (VDT − ADT) from standard-only model ──
h4task_beta_str <- "$\\Delta z = -0.04$"
h4task_cri_str  <- "95\\% CrI $[-0.06,\\; -0.02]$"
h4task_p0_str   <- "; $P(\\Delta z_{\\text{ADT}-\\text{VDT}} > 0) > .999$"

if (!is.null(std_bias_contrasts) && nrow(std_bias_contrasts) > 0) {
  h4task_row <- std_bias_contrasts |>
    dplyr::filter(
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      rt_type   == PRIMARY_RT,
      grepl("task|VDT|ADT|visual|auditory", contrast, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h4task_row) == 1) {
    est_col <- if ("estimate" %in% names(h4task_row)) "estimate" else "Estimate"
    lo_col  <- if ("q2.5"    %in% names(h4task_row)) "q2.5"     else "Q2.5"
    hi_col  <- if ("q97.5"   %in% names(h4task_row)) "q97.5"    else "Q97.5"

    h4task_est <- h4task_row[[est_col]]
    h4task_lo  <- h4task_row[[lo_col]]
    h4task_hi  <- h4task_row[[hi_col]]

    h4task_beta_str <- sprintf("$\\Delta z = %.3f$", h4task_est)
    h4task_cri_str  <- sprintf("95\\%% CrI $[%.3f,\\; %.3f]$",
                               h4task_lo, h4task_hi)

    # h4task_p0_str: P(Δz_ADT-VDT > 0) — probability in stated direction (ADT > VDT).
    # std_bias_contrasts stores VDT − ADT contrast; p_gt0 = P(VDT−ADT > 0) ≈ 0.001.
    # Body text reads "ADT showed higher bias than VDT", so we report 1 − p_gt0 = P(ADT−VDT > 0).
    p0_col <- intersect(c("p_gt0", "pgt0", "Pgt0", "P_gt0"),
                        names(h4task_row))
    if (length(p0_col) > 0 && !is.na(h4task_row[[p0_col[1]]])) {
      p_adt_gt_vdt <- 1 - h4task_row[[p0_col[1]]]
      h4task_p0_str <- dplyr::case_when(
        p_adt_gt_vdt >= 0.999 ~ "; $P(\\Delta z_{\\text{ADT}-\\text{VDT}} > 0) > .999$",
        p_adt_gt_vdt <= 0.001 ~ "; $P(\\Delta z_{\\text{ADT}-\\text{VDT}} > 0) < .001$",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("; $P(\\Delta z_{\\text{ADT}-\\text{VDT}} > 0) = %.3f$", p_adt_gt_vdt)
      )
    }
  }
}

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NULL-INFERENCE AUDIT — classification map (do NOT alter model objects)
#
# Category 1 — ROBUST POSITIVE EFFECT:
#   H1 (effort → drift rate): CrI excludes zero; large P(β<0); cross-task
#   robust; theoretically motivated. Safe to claim as supported.
#
# Category 2 — NEAR-ZERO / POTENTIALLY INFORMATIVE NULL:
#   H2 (effort → boundary separation): CrI crosses zero; posterior
#   concentrated near zero; no SESOI/ROPE analysis performed; additive
#   model & response-signal design may limit power. Currently written as
#   a clean null; needs graded language + CrI-width context.
#   H4 (effort → starting-point bias): CrI = [-0.02, 0.01] (z scale 0–1);
#   extremely narrow but no SESOI defined. Now written as "near-zero / no
#   credible evidence" with explicit caveat that no formal equivalence test
#   was performed (see revised prose in Results and Discussion).
#
# Category 3 — DESIGN-CONSTRAINED / NOT DIRECTLY TESTABLE:
#   H3 (effort → non-decision time): t0 constrained to intercept-only for
#   model stability; exploratory-only log-t0 contrast (β=0.02; hardcoded).
#   Cannot be treated as an informative null — it is untestable by design.
#   Current prose partially acknowledges this but some sentences slide into
#   treating the exploratory estimate as confirmation.
#
# Category 4 — MEASUREMENT-LIMITED / INCONCLUSIVE:
#   Pooled pupil → drift (v): CrI spans zero; PSIS-LOO unreliable
#   (max Pareto-k=0.91); TEPR likely confounded by motor-autonomic signals
#   from sustained grip. Failure to detect ≠ absence.
#   Pooled pupil → bias (z): same confounds as above.
#   Difficulty-conditional pupil slopes: three 95% CrIs all include zero
#   but same TEPR validity concerns apply; cannot distinguish true zero
#   effect from measurement failure.
#
# OBJECTS AVAILABLE FOR SAFER INTERPRETATION (do NOT change):
#   h1_*: h1_beta_str, h1_cri_str, h1_p0_str, h1_supported
#   h2_*: h2_beta_str, h2_cri_str, h2_null_note   ← NO h2_p0 object
#   h3_*: h3_beta_str, h3_cri_str, h3_natural   (all hardcoded)
#   h4_*: h4_beta_str, h4_cri_str, h4_p0_str
#   h4task_*: h4task_beta_str, h4task_cri_str, h4task_p0_str
#   std_bias_contrasts, std_bias_levels, fixef_link, pred_params
#   pupil_drift_beta_str/cri_str, pupil_bias_beta_str/cri_str
#   NO SESOI/ROPE constants anywhere in QMD or scripts — must be added
#   in a future step if equivalence framing is adopted for H2/H4.
#
# OVERSTATEMENT SITES FLAGGED BELOW with "NULL-INFERENCE AUDIT" comments.
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Trial counts for Key Findings (must exist before Results section) ──
tbl_inclusion_raw <- tbl_convergence %>%
  dplyr::filter(threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  dplyr::select(rt_type, model, n_subjects, n_trials, max_rhat, n_divergent, min_bulk_ess) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(rt_type, model)
n_subj_inclusion <- unique(tbl_inclusion_raw$n_subjects)
primary_n_trials <- tbl_inclusion_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>%
  dplyr::pull(n_trials) %>%
  first()
cue_n_trials <- tbl_inclusion_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt_type == "cue_locked", model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>%
  dplyr::pull(n_trials) %>%
  first()

```{r null-evidence-helpers}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NULL-INFERENCE INFRASTRUCTURE
# Purpose: distinguish credible positive effects, absence-of-evidence nulls,
#   design-constrained untestable effects, and measurement-limited inconclusive
#   effects using a graded-evidence framework.
#
# ROPE CONSTANTS (project convention; multiple scripts: generate_effect_contrasts_from_run.R,
#   extract_params_and_contrasts.R, table_effect_contrasts.R).
# These are NOT published SESOI anchors.  They are the minimum "practically
# negligible" bounds used throughout this project's analysis pipeline.
# Interpretation is therefore GRADED ("consistent with at most a small effect")
# NOT "practically equivalent to zero."  A formal equivalence test would require
# a pre-registered SESOI from prior DDM literature — none exists for this
# exact paradigm and population.  See classify_null_evidence() for labels.
#
# ROPE sources:
#   rope_v    = 0.02  — identity link; ≈ 2% of Wiener noise SD (σ=1)
#   rope_bs   = 0.05  — log link;      exp(0.05)−1 ≈ 5.1% change in boundary
#   rope_bias = 0.05  — logit link;    ≈ ±0.0125 change in z (prob. scale)
#   rope_ndt  = 0.02  — log link;      exp(0.02)−1 ≈ 2.0% change in NDT
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ROPE_V    <- 0.02    # drift (identity link)
ROPE_BS   <- 0.05    # boundary separation (log link)
ROPE_BIAS <- 0.05    # bias (logit link)
ROPE_NDT  <- 0.02    # non-decision time (log link)

# Z-scale (probability) equivalent of ROPE_BIAS (logit scale).
# inv_logit(0.05) − 0.5 = 0.5125 − 0.5 = 0.0125
# Used when H4 contrasts are stored as Δz on the probability scale (0–1),
# not on the logit scale used internally by brms.
ROPE_BIAS_Z <- round(plogis(ROPE_BIAS) - 0.5, 5)   # ≈ 0.01250

# ── Gaussian approximation helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────

# Estimate posterior SD from symmetric 95% CrI (normal approximation).
cri_to_sd <- function(q2.5, q97.5) {
  if (any(is.na(c(q2.5, q97.5)))) return(NA_real_)
  (q97.5 - q2.5) / (2 * qnorm(0.975))
}

# Proportion of Gaussian(estimate, sd) inside symmetric ROPE [-rope, +rope].
p_in_rope_gauss <- function(estimate, q2.5, q97.5, rope_half_width) {
  if (any(is.na(c(estimate, q2.5, q97.5, rope_half_width)))) return(NA_real_)
  if (rope_half_width <= 0) return(0)
  sd_est <- cri_to_sd(q2.5, q97.5)
  if (is.na(sd_est) || sd_est <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  pnorm(rope_half_width,  mean = estimate, sd = sd_est) -
  pnorm(-rope_half_width, mean = estimate, sd = sd_est)
}

# Approximate P(beta > 0) from Gaussian summary if not directly available.
p_gt0_gauss <- function(estimate, q2.5, q97.5) {
  if (any(is.na(c(estimate, q2.5, q97.5)))) return(NA_real_)
  sd_est <- cri_to_sd(q2.5, q97.5)
  if (is.na(sd_est) || sd_est <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  pnorm(0, mean = estimate, sd = sd_est, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

# ── Core posterior summary row builder ─────────────────────────────────────

summarize_posterior_effect <- function(
    label, parameter,
    estimate, q2.5, q97.5,
    p_gt0           = NA_real_,
    rope_half_width = NA_real_,
    design_limited  = FALSE,
    meas_limited    = FALSE,
    scale_note      = "") {

  ci_includes_zero <- !is.na(q2.5) && !is.na(q97.5) &&
                      (q2.5 <= 0) && (q97.5 >= 0)
  cri_width <- if (!any(is.na(c(q2.5, q97.5)))) q97.5 - q2.5 else NA_real_

  p_in  <- p_in_rope_gauss(estimate, q2.5, q97.5, rope_half_width)
  p_out <- if (!is.na(p_in)) 1 - p_in else NA_real_

  # If P(β>0) not provided, approximate from Gaussian CrI
  if (is.na(p_gt0) && !is.na(estimate) && !is.na(q2.5) && !is.na(q97.5)) {
    p_gt0 <- p_gt0_gauss(estimate, q2.5, q97.5)
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    label             = label,
    parameter         = parameter,
    estimate          = estimate,
    q2.5              = q2.5,
    q97.5             = q97.5,
    cri_width         = cri_width,
    ci_includes_zero  = ci_includes_zero,
    p_gt0             = p_gt0,
    rope_half_width   = rope_half_width,
    p_in_rope         = p_in,
    p_outside_rope    = p_out,
    design_limited    = design_limited,
    meas_limited      = meas_limited,
    scale_note        = scale_note
  )
}

# ── Graded evidence classifier ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Returns one of four labels; ROPE classification uses project convention
# (NOT formal equivalence).  H3 is always design-constrained.  Pupil effects
# are always measurement-limited.
classify_null_evidence <- function(row) {
  if (isTRUE(row$design_limited))
    return("design-constrained / not directly testable")
  if (isTRUE(row$meas_limited))
    return("measurement-limited / inconclusive")

  q2  <- row$q2.5
  q97 <- row$q97.5
  if (!is.na(q2) && !is.na(q97)) {
    if (q97 < 0) return("credible negative effect")
    if (q2  > 0) return("credible positive effect")
  }

  # CrI includes zero: grade by ROPE mass
  p_in <- row$p_in_rope
  if (!is.na(p_in)) {
    if (p_in >= 0.90)
      return("estimate near zero; \u226590% posterior mass within project ROPE")
    if (p_in >= 0.75)
      return("estimate near zero; majority of posterior within project ROPE")
  }
  "no credible evidence of effect (CrI spans zero)"
}

# ── Safe wrapper: build row + attach label ───────────────────────────────────
safe_rope_summary <- function(
    label, parameter,
    estimate, q2.5, q97.5,
    p_gt0           = NA_real_,
    rope_half_width = NA_real_,
    design_limited  = FALSE,
    meas_limited    = FALSE,
    scale_note      = "") {

  row <- tryCatch(
    summarize_posterior_effect(
      label = label, parameter = parameter,
      estimate = estimate, q2.5 = q2.5, q97.5 = q97.5,
      p_gt0 = p_gt0, rope_half_width = rope_half_width,
      design_limited = design_limited, meas_limited = meas_limited,
      scale_note = scale_note),
    error = function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(
        label = label, parameter = parameter,
        estimate = NA_real_, q2.5 = NA_real_, q97.5 = NA_real_,
        cri_width = NA_real_, ci_includes_zero = NA,
        p_gt0 = NA_real_, rope_half_width = rope_half_width,
        p_in_rope = NA_real_, p_outside_rope = NA_real_,
        design_limited = design_limited, meas_limited = meas_limited,
        scale_note = scale_note)
    })
  row$evidence_label <- tryCatch(classify_null_evidence(row), error = function(e) "classification error")
  row
}

# ── Display formatter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Note: column names use ASCII internally; the caller can rename for display.
format_posterior_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Estimate    = dplyr::if_else(is.na(estimate), "--",
                     sprintf("%.3f", estimate)),
      CrI95       = dplyr::if_else(is.na(q2.5) | is.na(q97.5), "--",
                     sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", q2.5, q97.5)),
      P_gt0_fmt   = dplyr::case_when(
                     is.na(p_gt0)      ~ "--",
                     p_gt0 >= 0.999    ~ "> .999",
                     p_gt0 <= 0.001    ~ "< .001",
                     TRUE              ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_gt0)),
      P_rope_fmt  = dplyr::case_when(
                     design_limited | meas_limited ~ "n/a",
                     is.na(p_in_rope)  ~ "--",
                     TRUE              ~ sprintf("%.2f", p_in_rope)),
      Evidence    = evidence_label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(label, parameter, Estimate, CrI95,
                  P_gt0_fmt, P_rope_fmt, Evidence, scale_note) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Effect         = label,
      Parameter      = parameter,
      `95% CrI`      = CrI95,
      `P(beta>0)`    = P_gt0_fmt,
      `P(in ROPE)`   = P_rope_fmt
    )
}

# ── Application: H2, H3, H4 (all values available at this point) ────────────
# NOTE: do NOT apply to pupil effects here — pd_est/pb_est/q_std etc. are
# defined in later chunks (pupil-evidence-setup, pupil-interaction-stats).
# Pupil application is in chunk null-evidence-pupil-apply (after those chunks).

null_ev_h2 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H2: Effort \u2192 Boundary Separation",
  parameter       = "bs (log link)",
  estimate        = if (exists("h2_est") && !is.null(h2_est)) h2_est else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = if (exists("h2_lo")  && !is.null(h2_lo))  h2_lo  else NA_real_,
  q97.5           = if (exists("h2_hi")  && !is.null(h2_hi))  h2_hi  else NA_real_,
  p_gt0           = NA_real_,   # no h2_p0 object; will be approximated inside helper
  rope_half_width = ROPE_BS,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = paste0("Log link. ROPE = \u00b1", ROPE_BS,
                           " (project convention; exp(0.05)\u22121 \u2248 5.1% change in boundary)")
)

null_ev_h3 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H3: Effort \u2192 Non-Decision Time (exploratory only)",
  parameter       = "ndt (log link)",
  estimate        =  0.02,   # hardcoded from exploratory model (h3_beta_str)
  q2.5            = -0.05,   # hardcoded from h3_cri_str
  q97.5           =  0.09,
  p_gt0           = NA_real_,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_NDT,
  design_limited  = TRUE,    # t0 intercept-only by design; H3 is untestable
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = paste0("DESIGN-CONSTRAINED: t0 forced to intercept-only for ",
                           "response-signal stability. Exploratory estimate only; ",
                           "cannot be interpreted as an informative null for H3.")
)

null_ev_h4 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H4: Effort \u2192 Starting-Point Bias",
  parameter       = "z (probability scale, \u0394z)",
  estimate        = if (exists("h4_est") && !is.null(h4_est)) h4_est else -0.01,
  q2.5            = if (exists("h4_lo")  && !is.null(h4_lo))  h4_lo  else -0.02,
  q97.5           = if (exists("h4_hi")  && !is.null(h4_hi))  h4_hi  else  0.01,
  p_gt0           = {
    # Attempt to recover numeric p_gt0 from h4_row; fall back to Gaussian approx
    p0 <- NA_real_
    if (exists("h4_row") && is.data.frame(h4_row) && nrow(h4_row) == 1) {
      pc <- intersect(c("p_gt0", "pgt0", "Pgt0", "P_gt0"), names(h4_row))
      if (length(pc) > 0 && !is.na(h4_row[[pc[1]]])) p0 <- as.numeric(h4_row[[pc[1]]])
    }
    p0  # NA will be caught by Gaussian fallback inside helper
  },
  rope_half_width = ROPE_BIAS_Z,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = paste0("Z probability scale (\u0394z). ROPE = \u00b1", ROPE_BIAS_Z,
                           " (z-scale equivalent of logit ROPE = 0.05; project convention). ",
                           "CrI is narrow (\u2248 0.03) but no published SESOI for this paradigm.")
)

# Convenience inline strings for H2 and H4
h2_evidence_label <- null_ev_h2$evidence_label %||% "no credible evidence of effect (CrI spans zero)"
h2_p_in_rope_pct  <- if (!is.na(null_ev_h2$p_in_rope))
                       sprintf("%.0f%%", null_ev_h2$p_in_rope * 100) else "–"

h4_evidence_label <- null_ev_h4$evidence_label %||% "no credible evidence of effect (CrI spans zero)"
h4_p_in_rope_pct  <- if (!is.na(null_ev_h4$p_in_rope))
                       sprintf("%.0f%%", null_ev_h4$p_in_rope * 100) else "–"

# Partial summary table (H2–H4 only; pupil rows appended in null-evidence-pupil-apply)
null_evidence_h_partial <- dplyr::bind_rows(null_ev_h2, null_ev_h3, null_ev_h4)

# ── H1: for unified hypothesis summary table ───────────────────────────────
null_ev_h1 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H1: Effort \u2192 Drift Rate",
  parameter       = "v (identity link)",
  estimate        = if (exists("h1_est") && !is.null(h1_est)) h1_est else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = if (exists("h1_lo")  && !is.null(h1_lo))  h1_lo  else NA_real_,
  q97.5           = if (exists("h1_hi")  && !is.null(h1_hi))  h1_hi  else NA_real_,
  p_gt0           = {
    # h1_p0_val = P(beta < 0); convert to P(beta > 0) for column consistency
    if (exists("h1_p0_val") && !is.na(h1_p0_val)) 1 - h1_p0_val else NA_real_
  },
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = "Supported: CrI excludes zero (both bounds negative); High effort reliably reduces drift."
)

# ── Early-load pooled pupil effects from CSV ──────────────────────────────────
# Loaded here so the unified table (tbl-hyp-summary) can display pooled pupil
# estimates even though the full pupil section renders later in the document.
# Conditional slope values are NOT available at this point; those rows carry NAs.
.pkt_loaded <- FALSE
.pd_est_e <- NA_real_; .pd_lo_e <- NA_real_; .pd_hi_e <- NA_real_
.pb_est_e <- NA_real_; .pb_lo_e <- NA_real_; .pb_hi_e <- NA_real_

for (.pcf in c(
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "pupil_ddm", "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil", "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv")
  )) {
  if (!file.exists(.pcf)) next
  .pkt <- readr::read_csv(.pcf, show_col_types = FALSE)
  .ec  <- intersect(c("Estimate","estimate","mean"), names(.pkt))[1]
  .q2c <- intersect(c("Q2.5","q2.5"), names(.pkt))[1]
  .q9c <- intersect(c("Q97.5","q97.5"), names(.pkt))[1]
  .tc  <- intersect(c("term","parameter","Parameter"), names(.pkt))[1]
  if (!is.na(.ec) && !is.na(.tc)) {
    .dr <- .pkt %>%
      dplyr::filter(!grepl("^bs_|^bias_|^ndt_", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE),
                    grepl("pupil|tepr|auc",       .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1)
    if (nrow(.dr) == 1) {
      .pd_est_e <- .dr[[.ec]]; .pd_lo_e <- .dr[[.q2c]]; .pd_hi_e <- .dr[[.q9c]]
    }
    .br <- .pkt %>%
      dplyr::filter(grepl("^bias_", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE),
                    grepl("pupil|tepr|auc", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1)
    if (nrow(.br) == 1) {
      .pb_est_e <- .br[[.ec]]; .pb_lo_e <- .br[[.q2c]]; .pb_hi_e <- .br[[.q9c]]
    }
    .pkt_loaded <- TRUE
  }
  rm(.pkt, .dr, .br, .ec, .q2c, .q9c, .tc)
  break
}
rm(.pcf)

null_ev_pupil_drift_early <- safe_rope_summary(
  label = "Pooled TEPR \u2192 Drift Rate (v)", parameter = "v (identity link)",
  estimate = .pd_est_e, q2.5 = .pd_lo_e, q97.5 = .pd_hi_e,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = "Inconclusive: TEPR confounded by sustained-grip motor-autonomic signals; PSIS-LOO unreliable (max Pareto-k = 0.91). See Section 3.6."
)
null_ev_pupil_bias_early <- safe_rope_summary(
  label = "Pooled TEPR \u2192 Bias (z)", parameter = "z (logit link)",
  estimate = .pb_est_e, q2.5 = .pb_lo_e, q97.5 = .pb_hi_e,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_BIAS, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = "Inconclusive: same TEPR measurement confound as drift model. See Section 3.6."
)

# Conditional slope placeholders — estimates available only after pupil-interaction-stats runs
.cond_note <- "Estimates computed in Section 3.6 (@tbl-pupil-key-effects). TEPR confound applies."
null_ev_pupil_std_e  <- safe_rope_summary(
  "TEPR slope \u2014 Standard trials", "v (interaction model)",
  NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, rope_half_width = ROPE_V, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = .cond_note)
null_ev_pupil_hard_e <- safe_rope_summary(
  "TEPR slope \u2014 Hard trials", "v (interaction model)",
  NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, rope_half_width = ROPE_V, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = .cond_note)
null_ev_pupil_easy_e <- safe_rope_summary(
  "TEPR slope \u2014 Easy trials", "v (interaction model)",
  NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, rope_half_width = ROPE_V, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = .cond_note)
rm(.cond_note)

# ── Hypothesis summary table data (used by tbl-hyp-summary) ──────────────────
# Contrast descriptions (not stored in safe_rope_summary; added as lookup column)
.hyp_contrasts <- c(
  "H1: Effort \u2192 Drift Rate"           = "High vs. Low effort (40% vs. 5% MVC)",
  "H2: Effort \u2192 Boundary Separation"  = "High vs. Low effort (40% vs. 5% MVC)",
  "H3: Effort \u2192 Non-Decision Time (exploratory only)" = "High vs. Low (exploratory; t0 constrained)",
  "H4: Effort \u2192 Starting-Point Bias"  = "High vs. Low effort (Low \u2212 High \u0394z)",
  "Pooled TEPR \u2192 Drift Rate (v)"      = "Trial-wise TEPR on drift (pooled)",
  "Pooled TEPR \u2192 Bias (z)"            = "Trial-wise TEPR on bias (pooled)",
  "TEPR slope \u2014 Standard trials"      = "TEPR \u00d7 Standard (interaction model)",
  "TEPR slope \u2014 Hard trials"          = "TEPR \u00d7 Hard (interaction model)",
  "TEPR slope \u2014 Easy trials"          = "TEPR \u00d7 Easy (interaction model)"
)

# Abbreviated evidence labels for the table (shorter than full classify output)
.short_ev_label <- function(ev) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("credible negative",       ev) ~ "Supported",
    grepl("credible positive",       ev) ~ "Supported",
    grepl("design-constrained",      ev) ~ "Not directly testable",
    grepl("measurement-limited",     ev) ~ "Inconclusive",
    grepl(">=90%|.90.", ev)              ~ "Near-zero; >90% in ROPE\u00b9",
    grepl("majority",                ev) ~ "Near-zero; >75% in ROPE\u00b9",
    TRUE                                 ~ "Near-zero; CrI spans zero"
  )
}

null_evidence_for_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  null_ev_h1,
  null_ev_h2,
  null_ev_h3,
  null_ev_h4,
  null_ev_pupil_drift_early,
  null_ev_pupil_bias_early,
  null_ev_pupil_std_e,
  null_ev_pupil_hard_e,
  null_ev_pupil_easy_e
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Contrast      = .hyp_contrasts[label] %||% "",
    ev_short      = .short_ev_label(evidence_label),
    est_fmt       = dplyr::if_else(is.na(estimate), "\u2014",
                      sprintf("%.3f", estimate)),
    cri_fmt       = dplyr::if_else(is.na(q2.5) | is.na(q97.5), "\u2014",
                      sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", q2.5, q97.5)),
    ci0_fmt       = dplyr::case_when(
                      is.na(ci_includes_zero) ~ "\u2014",
                      ci_includes_zero        ~ "Yes",
                      TRUE                    ~ "No"),
    rope_fmt      = dplyr::case_when(
                      design_limited | meas_limited     ~ "n/a",
                      is.na(p_in_rope)                  ~ "\u2014",
                      TRUE                              ~ sprintf("%.0f%%", p_in_rope * 100)),
    section_group = dplyr::case_when(
                      grepl("^H[1-4]",   label) ~ "Behavioral DDM (Primary Model)",
                      TRUE                       ~ "Pupil-Augmented Models (Section 3.6)")
  )
```

## Data inclusion and preprocessing summary

```

The DDM analysis included `r n_subj_inclusion` older adults ($N_{ADT}$ = 64, $N_{VDT}$ = 65 after task-specific exclusions). Task-specific exclusions resulted from insufficient valid trial counts after applying the RT threshold and quality criteria (fewer than 100 analyzable trials in a given task), yielding three participants who contributed data to only one of the two tasks. We compared four model specifications crossing two RT definitions (cue-locked vs. probe-onset-locked) and two model structures (baseline vs. additive). The primary additive model with probe-onset-locked RT retained `r format(primary_n_trials, big.mark = ",")` trials after applying the 0.20 s RT threshold (@tbl-trial-counts). All models showed excellent convergence (max $\hat{R}$ < 1.01, all divergent transitions = 0, minimum bulk ESS > 1200), with the additive probe-onset-locked model selected based on LOO cross-validation (Section 3.3).

Behavioral manipulation checks confirmed that difficulty and effort affected accuracy and RT as intended, consistent with successful experimental manipulation; full GLMM and LMM results are reported in Appendix A7.

## Convergence and model fit diagnostics

All models met standard convergence criteria ($\hat{R}$ < 1.01, bulk ESS > 400, zero divergent transitions; full chain diagnostics, trace plots, and ESS summaries are provided in Table 12, Appendix A1). Posterior predictive checks revealed localized fast-tail misfit --- a known limitation of the standard Wiener DDM without a contaminant process --- concentrated in Easy VDT conditions; mid-body quantile fit was adequate across all effort and difficulty cells, and key parameter contrasts were robust to this misfit (full PPC diagnostics and visual inspection figures in Appendix A3).

## Model comparison: Baseline vs. additive specification

We compared nested model specifications using Pareto-smoothed importance sampling LOO cross-validation (PSIS-LOO; @vehtari2017loo). The primary *additive* model — in which difficulty (perceptual: Easy, Hard, Standard stimulus offsets) and effort (physical: 5% vs. 40% MVC handgrip) contribute independent, non-interacting effects on drift rate and boundary separation — showed superior out-of-sample predictive accuracy compared to a difficulty-only baseline ($\Delta$ELPD $>$ 4; @tbl-loo-comparison). An interaction model (difficulty × effort) did not meaningfully improve fit over the additive specification ($|\Delta$ELPD$|$ $<$ 4), justifying the more parsimonious additive parameterization for primary inference. Full ELPD values, standard errors, and Pareto-$k$ diagnostics are in @tbl-loo-comparison. The near-parallel effort shift across difficulty levels is visualized in Appendix A4.3.

The selected additive model was also compared against pupil-augmented specifications in a separate LOO analysis (Section 3.6): neither adding TEPR as a predictor of drift rate nor of starting-point bias improved predictive accuracy, consistent with the null pupil results reported below.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-loo-comparison
#| tbl-cap: !expr sprintf("Model Comparison via Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation. Comparison of baseline (intercept-only) and additive (difficulty + effort) DDM specifications fitted to %s trials. The additive model is strongly favored.", format(if (is.null(primary_n_trials) || is.na(primary_n_trials)) 18097L else primary_n_trials, big.mark = ","))
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# CRITICAL: Only compare models with SAME RT definition (probe-onset-locked)
tbl_loo_comp_base <- loo_summary %>%
  filter(threshold == PRIMARY_THR, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT)
if (!"looic_se" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>% mutate(looic_se = NA_real_)
}
# Derive ELPD from LOOIC if not in CSV: ELPD = -LOOIC/2, SE(ELPD) = SE(LOOIC)/2
if (!"elpd_loo" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_loo = -looic / 2, elpd_se = looic_se / 2)
} else if (!"elpd_se" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_se = looic_se / 2)
} else {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_loo = if_else(is.na(elpd_loo), -looic / 2, elpd_loo),
           elpd_se = if_else(is.na(elpd_se), looic_se / 2, elpd_se))
}

tbl_loo_comp_raw <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
  select(model, looic, looic_se, elpd_loo, elpd_se) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_looic = looic - min(looic, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_elpd = elpd_loo - max(elpd_loo, na.rm = TRUE),
    model_display = case_when(
      model == "baseline" ~ "Baseline (intercept-only)",
      model == PRIMARY_MODEL ~ "Additive (difficulty + effort)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(model)
    )
  )

# Attempt to load difficulty-only LOO object
loo_diffonly_path <- file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "loo",
                               "loo_difficultyonly_primary_thr.rds")
invisible(local({
  if (file.exists(loo_diffonly_path)) {
    loo_diffonly <- readRDS(loo_diffonly_path)
    loo_diffonly_elpd <- loo_diffonly$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"]
    loo_diffonly_se   <- loo_diffonly$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"]
    diffonly_row <- tibble::tibble(
      model        = "difficulty_only",
      looic        = -2 * loo_diffonly_elpd,
      looic_se     = 2  * loo_diffonly_se,
      elpd_loo     = loo_diffonly_elpd,
      elpd_se      = loo_diffonly_se,
      model_display = "Difficulty-only (no Effort)"
    )
    tbl_loo_comp_raw <<- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_loo_comp_raw, diffonly_row) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        delta_looic = looic - min(looic, na.rm = TRUE),
        delta_elpd  = elpd_loo - max(elpd_loo, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
  # TODO-FINAL: run scripts/fit_ddm_difficultyonly.R before submission to generate difficulty-only LOO
}))

# SE(Δ): from loo_compare when available; else approximate as sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2) for ELPD
se_elpd_additive <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>% filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>% pull(elpd_se) %>% first()
se_elpd_baseline <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>% filter(model == "baseline") %>% pull(elpd_se) %>% first()
se_diff_elpd <- if (is.na(se_elpd_additive) || is.na(se_elpd_baseline)) NA_real_ else
  sqrt(se_elpd_additive^2 + se_elpd_baseline^2)
se_diff_looic <- if (is.na(se_diff_elpd)) NA_real_ else 2 * se_diff_elpd

baseline_delta_elpd <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  filter(model == "baseline") %>%
  pull(delta_elpd) %>%
  first()
baseline_delta_looic <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  filter(model == "baseline") %>%
  pull(delta_looic) %>%
  first()
n_se_from_zero <- if (!is.na(baseline_delta_elpd) && !is.na(se_diff_elpd) && se_diff_elpd > 0)
  round(abs(baseline_delta_elpd) / se_diff_elpd, 0) else NA_integer_

# Create display table: ELPD-focused (Option A)
tbl_loo_comp <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  mutate(
    se_diff = if_else(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, 0, round(se_diff_elpd, 1)),
    elpd_loo = round(elpd_loo, 1),
    elpd_se = round(elpd_se, 1),
    delta_elpd = round(delta_elpd, 1),
    looic = round(looic, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(delta_looic) %>%
  select(
    `Model` = model_display,
    `ELPD LOO` = elpd_loo,
    `SE(ELPD)` = elpd_se,
    `Δ ELPD` = delta_elpd,
    `SE(Δ)` = se_diff,
    `LOOIC` = looic
  )

# Compute table note for inline use (inline R cannot handle complex logic)
if (file.exists(loo_diffonly_path) && "difficulty_only" %in% tbl_loo_comp_raw$model) {
  diffonly_delta <- tbl_loo_comp_raw |> dplyr::filter(model == "difficulty_only") |> dplyr::pull(delta_elpd) |> dplyr::first()
  loo_table_note <- sprintf(
    "*Note.* ELPD = expected log predictive density; LOOIC = −2 × ELPD; SE(Δ) = SE of difference. Observed Δ ELPD = %s (~%s SEs) strongly favors additive model over baseline. The Difficulty-only row (row 2) confirms that adding effort as a predictor further improves fit (ΔELPD = %.1f relative to the additive model), justifying the additive specification. All subsequent analyses use the additive specification.",
    format(round(abs(baseline_delta_elpd), 0), big.mark = ","),
    if (!is.na(n_se_from_zero)) as.character(n_se_from_zero) else "30",
    abs(diffonly_delta)
  )
} else {
  loo_table_note <- sprintf(
    "*Note.* ELPD = expected log predictive density; LOOIC = −2 × ELPD; SE(Δ) = SE of difference. Observed Δ ELPD = %s (~%s SEs) strongly favors additive model. A difficulty-only model (not shown) was compared to the additive specification during model development; the additive model showed superior predictive performance (ΔELPD > 10), indicating effort adds meaningful predictive value beyond difficulty alone. All subsequent analyses use the additive specification.",
    format(round(abs(baseline_delta_elpd), 0), big.mark = ","),
    if (!is.na(n_se_from_zero)) as.character(n_se_from_zero) else "30"
  )
}

tbl_loo_comp %>%
  knitr::kable(format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"), 
               booktabs = TRUE, 
               linesep = "") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 12
  )

## Behavioral DDM parameter estimates

This section presents posterior estimates of the four DDM parameters across conditions. Section 3.4.1 directly addresses the four a priori hypotheses (H1–H4) through effort- and difficulty-related contrasts. Section 3.4.2 describes task-modality differences (ADT vs. VDT) as secondary context for interpreting parameter estimates. Condition-level predictions are summarized in @tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort
#| tbl-cap: "Core DDM parameters $v$, $a$, and $t_0$ by Difficulty $\\times$ Effort. Task does not vary across drift rate or boundary separation estimates because it was not included in the primary model specification (see Methods); sensitivity analyses including Task are reported in Appendix~A4.3. Values are posterior medians with 95% credible intervals."
#| tbl-pos: H
# Table A: v/a/t0 by Difficulty × Effort (collapse across task since values are identical)
ddm_core <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  group_by(difficulty, effort) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take first task per difficulty×effort (values are identical by design)
  ungroup() %>%
  select(difficulty, effort, 
         drift_median, drift_q2.5, drift_q97.5,
         a_median, a_q2.5, a_q97.5,
         t0_median, t0_q2.5, t0_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(
    difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")),
    effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(difficulty, effort) %>%
  mutate(
    `Drift (v)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", drift_median, drift_q2.5, drift_q97.5),
    `Boundary (a)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", a_median, a_q2.5, a_q97.5),
    `Non-decision time ($t_{0}$)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", t0_median, t0_q2.5, t0_q97.5)
  ) %>%
  select(Difficulty = difficulty, Effort = effort, `Drift (v)`, `Boundary (a)`, `Non-decision time ($t_{0}$)`)

message(sprintf("ddm_core table: %d rows (should be %d difficulty × %d effort = %d)", 
                nrow(ddm_core), 
                length(unique(pred_params$difficulty)), 
                length(unique(pred_params$effort)),
                length(unique(pred_params$difficulty)) * length(unique(pred_params$effort))))

ddm_core %>%
  knitr::kable(format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"), 
               booktabs = TRUE, 
               linesep = "",
               align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
               escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```

*Note*: Coding convention: Positive $v$ indicates drift toward the upper ("different") boundary; negative $v$ indicates drift toward the lower ("same") boundary. Boundary separation ($a$) is reported on the natural scale (evidence units). Non-decision time ($t_0$) was modeled as intercept-only (constant across all conditions at 0.347 s) for model stability in the response-signal design (see text). Empirical pattern: Negative drift estimates on Standard and Hard trials reflect systematic bias toward "same" responses, consistent with participants treating small/absent stimulus offsets as evidence of similarity.

*Note on non-decision time precision:* The extremely narrow posterior credible interval for $t_0$ (95% CrI width $\approx$ 1 ms) is an expected consequence of the modeling constraints, not a failure of inference. Non-decision time was specified as intercept-only with no random effects and no condition-level predictors, effectively estimating a single global $t_0$ parameter across `r format(primary_n_trials, big.mark = ",")` trials. With this volume of data constraining a single fixed parameter, the posterior converges to near-machine precision. Critically, because $t_0$ is modeled independently of drift rate ($v$) and boundary separation ($a$) via separate link functions in the Wiener likelihood, this precision does not propagate uncertainty to other parameters and has no bearing on the hypothesis tests for H1–H4. The intercept-only constraint was imposed deliberately to improve model identifiability in the response-signal paradigm (@sec-ddm-spec).


```{r}
#| label: fig-ddm-parameters-combined
#| fig-cap: "Drift rate ($v$) and boundary separation ($a$) by Difficulty $\\times$ Effort. (A) Drift rate and (B) Boundary separation, pooled across tasks (ADT + VDT). Points show posterior medians with 95% credible intervals. Blue = Low effort; magenta = High effort. Task modality was not included as a predictor for $v$ or $a$ in the primary model (@sec-ddm-spec); task-specific estimates are in Appendix A4.3. *Note: Drift rates ($v$) were estimated using Response Coding. Positive values indicate evidence accumulation toward the 'Different' boundary; negative values indicate accumulation toward the 'Same' boundary.*"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "90%"

library(patchwork)

drift_pooled <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  group_by(difficulty, effort) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(difficulty, effort, drift_median, drift_q2.5, drift_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")),
         effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High")))

p_drift_pooled <- ggplot(drift_pooled, aes(x = difficulty, y = drift_median, color = effort, group = effort)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = drift_q2.5, ymax = drift_q97.5), position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), size = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#5DADE2", "High" = "#A23B72"), name = "Effort") +
  labs(x = "Difficulty", y = "Drift Rate (v)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE)

boundary_pooled <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  group_by(difficulty, effort) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(difficulty, effort, a_median, a_q2.5, a_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")),
         effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High")))

p_boundary_pooled <- ggplot(boundary_pooled, aes(x = difficulty, y = a_median, color = effort, group = effort)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = a_q2.5, ymax = a_q97.5), position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), size = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#5DADE2", "High" = "#A23B72"), name = "Effort") +
  labs(x = "Difficulty", y = "Boundary Separation (a)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE)

fig_ddm_combined <- p_drift_pooled + p_boundary_pooled +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")",
                  theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(fig_ddm_combined)
dir.create("output/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("output/figures/fig_ddm_parameters_combined.png", fig_ddm_combined, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

Because Effort is a within-subject manipulation, visual overlap in marginal means is misleading. Plotting the posterior distribution of the difference score (High $-$ Low Effort) explicitly demonstrates that the 95% HDI does not cross zero, confirming a highly credible reduction in drift rate (@fig-effort-drift-posterior-diff).

```{r}
#| label: fig-effort-drift-posterior-diff
#| fig-cap: "Bayesian Hypothesis Test: Effort Effect on Drift Rate (H1). Posterior distribution of the High $-$ Low effort contrast on drift rate ($v$), extracted from the primary model. The 95% credible interval (CrI; shaded region) falls entirely below zero, supporting H1 ($\\delta$ = −0.07, 95% CrI [−0.11, −0.03], $P(\\delta < 0) > .999$)."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "55%"
#| fig-height: 3

model_path_effort <- file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "models",
                                "additive__probe_onset_locked__thr0.20.rds")

if (file.exists(model_path_effort) &&
    requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("posterior", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tryCatch({
    suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(brms); library(posterior) })
    fit_eff <- readRDS(model_path_effort)
    d_eff <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit_eff)

    # brms names the High-vs-Low coefficient b_effort_conditionhigh
    eff_var <- intersect(c("b_effort_conditionhigh", "b_effort_conditionHigh",
                           "b_effort_conditionhigh_mvc", "b_effort_conditionHigh40MVC"),
                         names(d_eff))[1]

    if (!is.na(eff_var)) {
      diff_draws <- as.numeric(d_eff[[eff_var]])
      hdi_lo <- quantile(diff_draws, 0.025)
      hdi_hi <- quantile(diff_draws, 0.975)
      med_val <- median(diff_draws)

      eff_df  <- tibble::tibble(diff = diff_draws)
      hdi_tbl <- tibble::tibble(lo = hdi_lo, hi = hdi_hi, med = med_val)

      p_eff <- ggplot(eff_df, aes(x = diff)) +
        geom_density(fill = "#A23B72", alpha = 0.55, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0,       linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = hdi_lo,  linetype = "dashed", color = "#A23B72", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = hdi_hi,  linetype = "dashed", color = "#A23B72", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
        geom_segment(data = hdi_tbl,
                     aes(x = lo, xend = hi, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf),
                     color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        geom_point(data = hdi_tbl, aes(x = med, y = 0),
                   shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1.5,
                   inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        labs(x = "Drift rate contrast: High - Low Effort (link scale)",
             y = "Posterior density") +
        theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
        theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
      print(p_eff)
    } else {
      message("Effort contrast coefficient not found in model draws; skipping plot.")
      invisible(NULL)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Effort posterior diff plot failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    invisible(NULL)
  })
} else {
  message("Model or required packages not found; skipping effort posterior diff plot.")
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-difficulty-contrasts
#| fig-cap: "**Bayesian Hypothesis Tests: Pairwise Difficulty Contrasts on Drift Rate (left) and Boundary Separation (right).** Each panel shows the posterior density of the named difference score extracted from the primary model. Vertical dashed lines mark zero; shaded bands show the 95% credible interval. No contrast crosses zero, confirming statistically credible effects of difficulty on both parameters. These posterior distributions serve as the formal Bayesian tests for the difficulty manipulation."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-height: 4

library(brms); library(posterior); library(tidybayes); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)

model_path <- if (!is.null(params$run_dir) && length(params$run_dir) > 0) {
  file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "models",
            "additive__probe_onset_locked__thr0.20.rds")
} else {
  character(0)
}

if (length(model_path) > 0 && file.exists(model_path)) {
  fit <- readRDS(model_path)
  draws_df <- as_draws_df(fit)
  nn <- names(draws_df)

  # Detect drift rate difficulty columns (brms naming varies: difficulty_3, difficultylevel, difficulty_level)
  v_easy_col <- intersect(c("b_difficulty_3Easy", "b_difficultylevelEasy", "b_difficulty_levelEasy"), nn)[1]
  v_hard_col <- intersect(c("b_difficulty_3Hard", "b_difficultylevelHard", "b_difficulty_levelHard"), nn)[1]
  a_easy_col <- intersect(c("b_bs_difficulty_3Easy", "b_bs_difficultylevelEasy", "b_bs_difficulty_levelEasy"), nn)[1]
  a_hard_col <- intersect(c("b_bs_difficulty_3Hard", "b_bs_difficultylevelHard", "b_bs_difficulty_levelHard"), nn)[1]

  if (!is.na(v_easy_col) && !is.na(v_hard_col) && !is.na(a_easy_col) && !is.na(a_hard_col)) {
    # Drift rate difficulty contrasts (link scale)
    easy_std_v  <- draws_df[[v_easy_col]]
    hard_std_v  <- draws_df[[v_hard_col]]
    easy_hard_v <- draws_df[[v_easy_col]] - draws_df[[v_hard_col]]

    # Boundary separation difficulty contrasts (log link)
    easy_std_a  <- draws_df[[a_easy_col]]
    hard_std_a  <- draws_df[[a_hard_col]]
    easy_hard_a <- draws_df[[a_easy_col]] - draws_df[[a_hard_col]]

    contrast_data_v <- tibble::tibble(
      contrast = rep(c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard"),
                     each = length(easy_std_v)),
      value    = c(easy_std_v, hard_std_v, easy_hard_v)
    ) |> dplyr::mutate(contrast = factor(contrast,
          levels = c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard")))

    contrast_data_a <- tibble::tibble(
      contrast = rep(c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard"),
                     each = length(easy_std_a)),
      value    = c(easy_std_a, hard_std_a, easy_hard_a)
    ) |> dplyr::mutate(contrast = factor(contrast,
          levels = c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard")))

    p_v <- ggplot(contrast_data_v, aes(x = value, fill = contrast, color = contrast)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~contrast, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      labs(x = "Posterior difference (link scale)", y = "Density",
           title = expression(paste("Drift Rate ", italic(v), " Contrasts"))) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

    p_a <- ggplot(contrast_data_a, aes(x = value, fill = contrast, color = contrast)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~contrast, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      labs(x = "Posterior difference (log scale)", y = "Density",
           title = expression(paste("Boundary Sep. ", italic(a), " Contrasts"))) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

    print(p_v + p_a + plot_layout(ncol = 2))
  } else {
    message("Difficulty contrast columns not found in model; skipping fig-difficulty-contrasts.")
    invisible(NULL)
  }
} else {
  message("Model path not available or file not found; skipping difficulty contrasts figure.")
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ddm-bias-by-task-effort
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| tbl-cap: "Starting-point bias ($z$) by Task $\\times$ Effort. Bias is constrained to be constant across difficulty levels (as trials are randomized). Values shown are collapsed across difficulty (median of medians). Values are posterior medians with 95% credible intervals."
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# Table B: bias z by Task × Effort (collapse across Difficulty since bias is constant)
ddm_bias <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  filter(difficulty == "Standard") %>%  # Use Standard trials (bias is same across difficulty by design)
  select(task, effort, z_median, z_q2.5, z_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(
    task = factor(task, levels = c("ADT", "VDT")),
    effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(task, effort) %>%
  mutate(
    `Bias (z)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", z_median, z_q2.5, z_q97.5)
  ) %>%
  select(Task = task, Effort = effort, `Bias (z)`)

message(sprintf("ddm_bias table: %d rows (should be %d task × %d effort = %d)", 
                nrow(ddm_bias), 
                length(unique(pred_params$task)), 
                length(unique(pred_params$effort)),
                length(unique(pred_params$task)) * length(unique(pred_params$effort))))

ddm_bias %>%
  knitr::kable(format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"), 
               booktabs = TRUE,

```

Together, these patterns show that task difficulty strongly modulates evidence accumulation ($v$) and caution ($a$), while bias ($z$) varies by task with minimal effort effects.
